description_en: Add a resource reference to a workspace
description_zh: 添加资源引用到工作空间
name: CreateWorkspaceResource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace. To obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
The creation behavior. Valid values:

`CreateAndAttach`: Creates a resource and attaches it to the workspace.

`Attach`: Attaches an existing resource to the workspace. This option requires you to specify the `Name`, `ResourceType`, `GroupName`, and `EnvType` parameters.

MaxCompute resources only support the `Attach` option
parameters.help_zh:
创建行为，取值如下：
CreateAndAttach：创建资源并绑定到工作空间。
Attach：绑定资源到工作空间。Detach和Attach必填参数为Name、ResourceType、GroupName、EnvType。
MaxCompute只支持Attach
parameters.name: option

fields.help_en:
The environment type. Valid values:

`dev`: development environment

`prod`: production environment
fields.help_zh:
环境类型， 取值如下：
dev：开发环境
prod：生产环境
fields.name: env_type

fields.help_en: The name of the resource group. The name must be unique within an Alibaba Cloud account. This parameter is required for MaxCompute, ECS, Lingjun, ACS, and Flink resources
fields.help_zh: 资源分组名，主账户内唯一。对于MaxCompute、ECS、Lingjun、ACS、FLINK都是必填
fields.name: group_name

fields.help_en:
Indicates whether this is the default resource for its type. Each resource type can have only one default resource.

`false` (default): The resource is not the default resource.

`true`: The resource is the default resource
fields.help_zh:
是否为默认资源（每种资源类型有一个默认的资源）。取值如下：
false（默认值）：不是默认资源
true：是默认资源
fields.name: is_default

fields.help_en:
The resource name. The name must meet the following requirements:

Must be 3 to 28 characters long, start with a letter, and can contain only letters, digits, and underscores (_).

Must be unique within the same region.

If `Option` is set to `Attach` and `ResourceType` is set to `MaxCompute`, this parameter specifies the project name
fields.help_zh:
资源名。格式如下。
长度为3~28个字符，以字母开头，只能包含字母、数字和下划线（_）。
同地域内唯一。
Option为Attach、Detach时，对于ResourceType为MaxCompute Name，Name为ProjectName
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated and will be removed in a future version. Use the `ResourceType` parameter instead
fields.help_zh: 该字段已废弃，将会下线，请使用ResourceType字段
fields.name: product_type

fields.help_en:
The ID of the resource quota. To obtain the resource quota ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449144.html. This parameter is required only for subscription MaxCompute resources.
For ECS, Lingjun, and ACS resources, you do not need to specify this parameter. Their quota information is configured in the `Spec` parameter
fields.help_zh:
资源配额ID。如何获取资源配额ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449144.html，只有预付费MaxCompute资源需要填入该字段。
对于ECS、Lingjun、ACS不用填入该字段，Quota信息都在Spec里设置
fields.name: id

fields.help_en: The resource quotas. Currently, only MaxCompute resources have resource quotas
fields.help_zh: 资源配额列表，目前只有MaxCompute资源有资源配额
fields.name: quotas

fields.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

`MaxCompute`: MaxCompute resources

`ECS`: general-purpose computing resources

`Lingjun`: Lingjun intelligent computing resources

`ACS`: ACS computing resources

`Flink`: Flink resources

`SelfManagedAckPro`: unified managed cluster resource (AckPro)

`SelfManagedAckLingjun`: unified managed cluster resource (AckLingjun)

`SelfManagedASI`: unified managed cluster resource for third-party clouds (ASI)
fields.help_zh:
资源类型列表。取值如下：

MaxCompute：大数据计算服务资源
ECS：通用计算资源
Lingjun：灵骏智算资源
ACS：ACS计算资源
FLINK：Flink资源
SelfManagedAckPro：AckPro统一管控集群资源
SelfManagedAckLingjun：AckLinjun统一管控集群资源 
SelfManagedASI：ASI统一管控集群资源（三方云）
fields.name: resource_type

fields.help_en:
The resource specification in JSON format. For ECS and Lingjun resources, the format is as follows: {
"clusterType": "The type of the cluster", "resourceId": "The ID of the quota", "resourceName": "The name of the quota" } The `clusterType` parameter can have the following values:
`share`: shared resource group `private`: dedicated resource group `FullyManaged`: fully managed ACS resource
fields.help_zh:
资源规格说明，JSON格式。
对于ECS、Lingjun，该字段格式为
{        
        "clusterType": "cluster类型",
        "resourceId": "quota的Id",
        "resourceName": "quota的名字"
}
cluster取值如下：

share：公共资源组
private：专有资源组
FullyManaged：ACS 全托管资源
fields.name: spec

fields.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the resource belongs. To obtain the workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
fields.help_zh: 所属的工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
fields.name: workspace_id
